label:
Heat-precipitated
whey protein
step: heat and acidify, collect the flocs
note: The same chemistry as ricotta, run in a plant: the product goes back into cheese milk (a Camembert trial gained 12 % yield) or into spreads.

about.text: Whey protein pushed out of whey by heat and acid as a soft coagulum, then separated by centrifuge. 90-95 % of the coagulable protein is recovered as a 12-15 % protein-solids concentrate.

steps.note: A solids-ejecting clarifier discharges about every 3 min.
